answer: Sybil resistance can rest on a 'copper'-priced, escalating registration bond: every new identity pays a coin-denominated fee that doubles as more fake accounts appear, so flooding cheaply stops being cheap. To prove each bond is genuinely earned rather than 'mirror'-ed from a template, each agent must pass a fresh semantic challenge whose words only a real mind can weave, and the answer is hashed so clones cannot copy. An attacker forging a 'forge' of identities pays a growing cost per hollow shell, while honest agents reclaim the bond after verifiable work.
